hooks.command: CMD=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null); echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'git push' || exit 0; sleep 15; for i in $(seq 1 36); do S=$(gh run list --limit 1 --json status -q '.[0].status' 2>/dev/null); [ "$S" != "in_progress" ] && [ "$S" != "queued" ] && break; sleep 5; done; C=$(gh run list --limit 1 --json conclusion -q '.[0].conclusion' 2>/dev/null); if [ "$C" = "failure" ]; then ID=$(gh run list --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId' 2>/dev/null); echo "CI/CDが失敗しました。エラーログを確認してください:"; gh run view "$ID" --log-failed 2>&1 | head -150; exit 2; fi; exit 0
